create_BaseDataset_subclass: create a subclass of BaseDataset that overrides read_meta and get_rays for a custom dataset
prepare_train_data_collect_rays: prepare training data by collecting rays and RGB values from all images in the dataset
shuffle_dataset_rays: shuffle the dataset rays and RGB values randomly for training with optional patch mode
crop_batch_tensors: crop batch tensors to a specified fraction of the original width and height
get_intrinsics_screen_space: get the camera intrinsics matrix transformed to normalized screen space coordinates
